On #WorldDownSyndromeDay, we celebrate the acceptance of people with Down Syndrome & the continued work to provide funding for research & resources for bettering critical health & quality-of-life needs for individuals with Down Syndrome.

On #NationalDoctorsDay, we recognize physicians across America for their lifesaving work, especially throughout the coronavirus pandemic. Their contributions to the health our communities cannot be thanked enough! 🩺

On #NationalNursesDay, we extend our deepest gratitude to nurses across the country & in our communities for their dedication to keeping us healthy, taking care of patients in critical & emergency situations & so much more. We cannot thank you enough for all you do!

During #SuicidePreventionAwarenessMonth, we recognize the importance of letting our loved ones know they are not alone & remembering that conversations can save lives. As we battle this terrible epidemic, please prioritize your mental health & know when to seek help.

On this #WorldAlzDay, we recognize the importance of identifying symptoms & risk factors early on, advancing diagnostics & treatments to improve the lives of patients & eventually finding a cure for this terrible disease through biomedical research. #EndALZ
